title: Assistant Designer, Footwear
note: Footwear design role at Madewell's NYC headquarters asking for 0–2 years of footwear design experience.

facts.summary: Junior footwear designer supporting seasonal collections from concept through production.
facts.duties: Trend and material research, sketches and technical drawings, colorways, mood boards and line plans, tech packs, sample reviews with feedback, working with merchandising and sourcing.
facts.requirements: 0–2 years footwear design experience; knowledge of footwear construction and materials; Illustrator and Photoshop; strong sketching; bachelor's in fashion, footwear or related field preferred.
facts.apply: Apply through the J.Crew Group Workday careers site.
